target_customer: Independent clinics and their admin teams that handle patient billing and insurance tasks
problem: Clinics lose time and revenue on manual insurance verification, prior authorization and claim status checks on payer portals, and cannot tell patients what they owe at the visit.

founders.name: Andrew Tang
founders.background_notes: Founding engineer at CancerIQ building EHR integrations.

founders.name: Shreya Jagarlamudi
founders.background_notes: Software engineer on healthcare and ML at Microsoft per the YC launch post; not listed in the YC founders section.

technical_complexity.rationale: Estimating coverage and automating payer portals needed EHR integrations and brittle browser automation, standard but fiddly engineering for two people.

defensibility.rationale: Portal automation and EHR integrations are copyable and payer portals change often; value rested on integration depth with each clinic.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent clearinghouses and RCM vendors served the same tasks; the company was instead acquired by Collectly in March 2026.

market_need_then: Insurance admin work is a known cost for clinics; no dated spend or complaint figures were found in this research.

branding.domain_note: Used pledge.health, a .health domain, no purchase details found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found; name is shared with unrelated companies named Pledge.

pivots.from: Automated patient billing for independent clinics that estimates insurance coverage per visit
pivots.to: AI browser assistant for insurance tasks across payer portals from the EHR
pivots.why: Not stated; dates approximate from changing YC descriptions.

outcome_analysis: Pledge Health stayed a two person team after YC W23, repositioned from patient billing estimates to AI assistants for payer portal tasks, and was acquired by Collectly in March 2026 at undisclosed terms. Public evidence of traction or funding scale is thin, so whether this was a strong outcome or a soft landing is not known.
notes: Company site pledge.health returned HTTP 503 on fetch. Funding is unverified: VCBacked lists a 1.0M seed in May 2023 with Y Combinator, Village and Extruct list 500K, CB Insights lists 1.5M over 5 rounds; these are aggregators only, so no round is recorded. Acquisition date of 2026-03-26 comes from trade press; terms undisclosed. Headquarters conflicts between Seattle and New York across sources. No dated competitor sources near the batch were found (searches returned 2026 listicles), so the list is empty.
